facts.fact: The ESCWA profile says Egypt's ICT strategy exists, with the latest edition the National ICT Strategy 2013-2017 dated April 2013, run by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology.
The profile gives the strategy's period as 2013-2017, with its targets set to the 2017/2018 financial year.
The profile names the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology as the government agency in charge, to implement the strategy's programmes with partners.
The profile footnotes the strategy to a publication page on the MCIT website (mcit.gov.eg).

The profile lists seven pillars of programmes and measurable targets by financial year, such as 100% broadband connection by 2017/2018 and ICT exports of 28 billion EGP in 2017/2018, with an estimated 45 billion EGP of investment for connectivity but no costed plan.
The profile rates the strategy's pace of implementation as excellent, without giving progress against its targets.
